verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MU mikono gyo, Yesu,
Tuleeta-omwana-ono;
Ku Bbatirizo lino,
Tukusaba-omukuume.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Tumanyi-okwagala kwo
Eri-abaana bonna;
Kubanga wabanenya
Abaali babagoba.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naffe leero tusaba
Bwe tuleeta ono
Omutuule-omwana wo
-Emirembe n'emirembe.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Omulabe wa maanyi,
Naye wamusinga
Otukuume mu kkubo,
Otutuuse mu ggulu.
